svg.title: Жим гири лёжа одной рукой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. New pose, reference only for style. SINGLE ARM KETTLEBELL FLOOR PRESS, viewed from above head at a high 3/4 angle so both shoulders distinctly visible. Both figures face up on floor, bent knees, planted feet. The same anatomically right arm on viewer LEFT holds one round kettlebell with loop handle in BOTH phases. Left panel right elbow bent 90 degrees with upper arm on floor. Right panel same arm extended straight up with kettlebell over right shoulder. Anatomically left arm lies straight out on floor to viewer RIGHT in BOTH panels, empty hand clearly visible. Exactly two arms each, no bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
